Our gardens / The Rose Walk

Planting schemes · Bradford-on-Avon

The Rose Walk

A narrow passage becomes a soft, fragrant connection between garden rooms.

Location
Bradford-on-Avon
Garden size
60 m²
Service
Planting design
Concept year
2024

The starting point

A narrow route was being used only to get from one end of the garden to the other. The owners wanted that journey to feel like part of the garden itself, with fragrance and a longer flowering season.

The approach

The route stays clear and practical. Planting works vertically as well as at ground level, with a light framework for roses and space to reach the plants for pruning.

Room to grow

Repeat-flowering roses are supported by hardy perennials and low ground cover. The care notes explain pruning, feeding and how to keep the path comfortably open.

Illustrative project brief; photography shows garden inspiration, not work by a real Fieldwork studio.
